# nlohmann/json 3.12.0

Vendored single header, used privately by `dungeon_project_io` and its tests.
It is not included by the core or exported in a public header.

- Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0
- Header: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- SHA-256: `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`
- License: MIT, preserved in `LICENSE.MIT`.

Ordinary builds are offline and never fetch this dependency. Version updates
must update the header, preserved license, provenance/hash, and persistence tests.
